verdict.rationale: Runtime probes confirm a live llms.txt at developer.paypal.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200, titled PayPal Developer Documentation). They also confirm per-page markdown renditions of the agentic docs, e.g. /agent-ready/overview.md, so an agent can be pointed straight at agent-readable docs for this product. Missing for 10: verified coverage of the agentic-commerce sections (Store Sync, cart API, agent tools) within the truncated llms.txt index, and independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent consuming these docs successfully.
